operative_clauses.judgment_reason: The sole operative paragraph amends Executive Order 12187 so that section 1-101 sets the base production control level for marginal properties for the months January to March 1980, section 1-102 defines marginal properties by reference to the crude oil pricing regulations, and section 1-103 lets the Secretary of Energy conform those regulations; the order has no sunset or effective-date wording of its own. Executive Order 12553 of February 25, 1986 orders that the listed Executive Orders, "any amendments thereto, are revoked:" and lists the number 12209 in the No. column of its revocation table (offset 26806 of the held text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12553.txt). This is an express revocation that names this order. EO 12553 has no effective-date wording, so the first-end date is its signing date, 1986-02-25; that is a reading of the text, not express wording, and the Federal Register publication date 1986-03-03 and filing date 1986-02-26 are not effective dates. Earlier candidates that do not name EO 12209 (the period of section 1-101 ending 1980-03-31, EO 12287 of 1981-01-28, the believed 1981-09-30 lapse of the statutory authority) are disclosed but not adopted, because none names this order or is shown to have extinguished its sections.
operative_clauses.original_operative_text:
By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution and statutes of 
the United States o f Am erica, including the Em ergency Petroleum A llocation 
A ct of 1973, as am ended (15 U.S.C. 751 e t  s e q .) , and notw ithstanding the 
delegations to the Secretary of Energy in Executive O rder No. 11790, as 
am ended by Executive Order No. 12038, and in order to permit the conversion 
to new  oil status o f all old oil production from m arginal oil w ells effective 
April 1,1980, it is hereby ordered that Executive O rder No. 12187 of D ecem ber 
29,1979, is am ended to read as follow s:
“1-101. For purposes o f the pricing regulations adopted pursuant to the 
Em ergency Petroleum A llocation A ct of 1973, w ith respect to the m onths of 
January, February and M arch 1980, the b ase production control level for 
marginal properties shall equal 20 percent of the total num ber of barrels of old 
crude oil produced and sold from the property concerned during calendar year 
1978, divided by 365, multiplied by the num ber of days during the month in 
1978 w hich corresponds to the months concerned.”
“1-102. For purposes of this Order, the term “m arginal properties” has the 
sam e meaning as that term under the crude oil pricing regulations adopted 
pursuant to the Em ergency Petroleum A llocation A ct of 1973, as am ended.”
“1-103. The Secretary of Energy may, pursuant to Executive Order No. 11790, 
as am ended by Executive Order No. 12038, adopt such regulations as he 
deems n ecessary  or appropriate to conform the crude oil pricing regulations to 
this Order.”.

EO 12209 (signed 1980-04-16; 45 FR 26311) was read in full in the held Federal Register text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12209.txt. It is a single amending paragraph that restates sections 1-101 to 1-103 of Executive Order 12187. The dossier evidence ACT:EO:12209>EO:12553 (an agent-located, independently reviewed provision) was re-read against the held EO 12553 text, whose revocation table lists the number 12209. The LOOKUPS number-citation search of the held order texts finds no order other than EO 12553 that names EO 12209. The machine searches (U.S. Code 0 hits, eCFR 0 hits, Federal Register catalog 2 hits that are EO 12553 and EO 12919) were read: EO 12919 only amends EO 11790 and does not name EO 12209. EO 12287 (1981-01-28), read in the held Federal Register text, decontrols crude oil and petroleum products without naming EO 12187 or EO 12209. Under the owner rulings of 2026-10-21 (unnamed instruments) and 2026-10-28 (an endpoint needs a reason), the end is the instrument that names this order, EO 12553, and the unnamed candidates are disclosed. savings_residuals.reason: The order converted old oil from marginal oil wells to new oil status effective April 1, 1980 and fixed the base production control level for January to March 1980; those pricing consequences for past periods are accrued effects. operative_clauses.judgment_reason: The sole paragraph restates sections 1(b) and 1(c) of Executive Order 11896: the Mission assists implementation of Annex I and its Appendix of the Treaty of Peace between Egypt and Israel by verifying zones and force levels and technical installations and conducting other assigned tasks, under policy guidance through the Assistant to the President for National Security Affairs and the supervision of the Secretary of State, and the Mission has the duty to ensure that the United States role enhances compliance in good faith. It has no sunset of its own. Executive Order 12553 of February 25, 1986 orders that the listed Executive Orders, "any amendments thereto, are revoked:" and lists the number 12227 in the No. column of its revocation table (offset 26818 of the held text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12553.txt). This is an express revocation that names this order. EO 12553 has no effective-date wording, so the first-end date is its signing date, 1986-02-25; that is a reading of the text, not express wording, and the Federal Register publication date 1986-03-03 and filing date 1986-02-26 are not effective dates. Executive Order 12357 of 1982-04-06 adds new subsections to section 2 of EO 11896, does not touch sections 1(b) or 1(c), and its direction to terminate all Mission functions not later than 1982-09-30 is a disclosed not-later-than bound that names neither this order nor a completion date, so it is not adopted as the end.

By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution and statutes of  
the United States of Am erica, including Chapter 6 of Part II of the Foreign  
A ssistance A ct of 1961, as amended (22 U.S.C. 2348, 2348a.-2348c.J, Sections  
1(b) and 1(c) of Executive Order No. 11896 of January 13, 1976, as amended,  
are hereby further amended to read as follows:
“(b) The Mission shall, in accordan ce with the Foreign A ssistance A ct of 1961,  
as amended, including Part II, Chapter 6 thereof, the Joint Resolution of  
O ctober 13 ,1 9 7 5  (Public Law  94-110, 89 Stat. 572, 22 U.S.C. 2441 note), and the  
provisions of this Order, assist in the implementation of the provisions of  
A nnex I and the Appendix to A nnex I of the T reaty of P eace betw een the  
A rab Republic of Egypt and the State of Israel, signed M arch 26, 1979. The  
Mission shall assist by (i) verifying Zones A  and B and the provisions of  
A nnex I of the T reaty relating to force levels, fortifications, and installations  
by on the ground inspections and reconnaissance flights, (ii) verifying the  
technical installations within the Interim Buffer Zone as provided in Article  
V(3)(c) of the Appendix to A nnex I of the Treaty, and (iii) conducting other  
assigned tasks in order to further the implementation of the T reaty of Peace.  
.Such assistance shall be subject to broad policy guidance received through the  
A ssistant to the President for National Security Affairs, and the continuous  
supervision and general direction of the Secretary o f State pursuant to Section  
622(c) of the Foreign A ssistance A ct of 1961, as amended (22 U.S.C. 2382).”
“(c) It shall be the duty and responsibility of the M ission to ensure that the  
United States role enhances the prospect of com pliance in good faith with the  
terms of the Egyptian-Israeli agreem ent and thereby prom otes the cause of  
p eace.”.

operative_clauses.judgment_reason: The order amends Executive Order 12503 by changing the commission’s name in the title and section 1(a) to President’s Commission on Americans Outdoors and by restating section 4(b) so that the Commission submits its report no later than 1986-12-31 and "shall terminate 30 days after its report". Executive Order 12610 of September 30, 1987 states in its section 3 that the listed Executive Orders, which established committees that have terminated or whose work is completed, are revoked, and the list includes "(e) Executive Order No. 12503, as amended by Executive Order No. 12529," establishing the President’s Commission on Americans Outdoors. That is an express revocation that names this order as the amendment of EO 12503. Its section 5 states "Sec. 5. This Order shall be effective September 30,1987." The report deadline of 1986-12-31 and the 30-day report-relative termination are spent facts and not ends under the owner ruling of 2026-10-21; the actual report date is not held. EO 12610 recites that the listed committees have terminated or completed their work, without a date, which is disclosed.

laws of the United States of America, including the Defense Production Act of  
1950, as amended (50 U.S.C. App. 2061 et seq.),  and in order to provide for the

Congress required by Section 309 of the Defense Production Act.”
